messages.author: e13072fd07a5d80a
messages.subject: Unable to install shinyapps package
parts:
Hi,

I am getting a 404 Not Found error when trying to install the shinyapps package.  Do you have any ideas on what may be causing this error?

> devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')
Installing github repo(s) rstudio/shinyapps/master from hadley
Downloading rstudio/shinyapps.zip from https://github.com/hadley/rstudio/shinyapps/archive/master.zip
Error: client error: (404) Not Found


Thanks,
Josh

messages.author: a58a2a3609db3342
messages.subject: Re: Unable to install shinyapps package
parts:
I suspect its a typo. Try

devtools::install_github('shinyapps', 'rstudio')

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Unable to install shinyapps package
parts:
John, 

You are correct. There was a typo in the guide. The syntax below is only supported on the latest version of devtools (>= 1.4).

devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')
 To update devtools from 1.3 (which the latest version on CRAN), to 1.4 you need to run:

devtools::install_github('hadley', 'devtools')
After that, you can use the new syntax for install_github from above.

Sorry for the confusion.

-Andy

parts:
Josh,

It looks like you're using OSX. Do you have the XCode Command Line Tools installed? This is usually required to build R packages from source if they have native code.

I believe you can download the XCode Command Line Tools from Apple's website (https://developer.apple.com/downloads/index.action#), but you will need to create an account, and find the correct download for the version of OSX you are running.

-Andy
